headline: Bitcoin holds near $78.8k amid consolidation, eyes key $79.5k resistance
btc_thesis: On the 1‑hour chart BTC is forming a descending channel, holding above the 77,800 support while testing the 79,500 resistance; the 4‑hour view shows a flat range, suggesting a short‑term liquidity grab.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into high‑momentum tokens, led by QKC, FORM, FF and DOT, indicating capital shifting from BTC to risk‑on assets.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders should consider buying on dips near $77,800 with a tight stop; futures players can sell short the next test of $79,500 resistance.
